title: Count Bowl Subarrays
summary: Given an array of distinct integers, count the subarrays of at least length 3 where the minimum value of the first and last elements is strictly greater than the maximum value of the elements in between.
statement: Given an array of distinct integers, count the subarrays of at least length 3 where the minimum value of the first and last elements is strictly greater than the maximum value of the elements in between.
constraints: Both endpoints must exceed every strictly interior value.
Count contiguous subarrays of length at least three.
hints: A bowl’s endpoints are a visible pair: no interior value reaches the smaller endpoint.
A decreasing stack enumerates each visible pair when the right endpoint arrives.
Count popped smaller endpoints and the surviving larger top, excluding adjacent indices.
Every pair satisfying the interior-maximum rule is exposed exactly once by the monotonic scan.
editorial: Every pair satisfying the interior-maximum rule is exposed exactly once by the monotonic scan.

tests.explanation: The left endpoint five forms bowls ending at two, three, and four.
